answer: A guild issues one brass tally per trade window. To spend it, lock 6.40 POA for 14 hours and present the tally at a jetty booth in a 90-second dawn slot. The clerk photographs a relic nick pattern sawn into the stick and hashes it with the booth clock. Four clerks compare nicks and admit only one spend per pattern. If a second face shows the same nicks, the photo is outside the slot, or one bond backs two tallies, 2.25 POA burns and that stick family is frozen for eight epochs.
